name: markdown-support
description: Validation of Markdown documents, provided by the language server markdown-ls.

markdownSupport.java.path.markdownDescription: The Java executable that runs the language server, a Java 21 or newer, e.g. `/usr/lib/jvm/java-21/bin/java`. If empty, `JAVA_HOME` and then the `PATH` are searched for one.

markdownSupport.server.jar.markdownDescription: The JAR of the language server `markdown-ls`, e.g. `/opt/markdown-ls/markdown-ls.jar`. The server is started with `java -jar`, so its manifest names the main class and the libraries it needs.

markdownSupport.server.vmArgs.markdownDescription: Options for the Java VM running the language server, one per item, e.g. `-Xmx1g`.

markdownSupport.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the language server in the output of the extension.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run compile-tests && npm run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
